Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the organization of the department of social and health services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the organization of the department of social andhealth services; amending RCW 43.20A.090 and 71.24.360; and adding anew section to chapter 43.20A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall adopt a rule specifying the number andgeographic boundaries of the department's regional service deliverysystem. (2) Each departmental administration and division shall reorganizeits delivery system to be consistent with the department's regionalboundaries.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.20A.090 and 1994 sp.s. c 7 s 515 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary shall appoint a deputy secretary, a departmentpersonnel director, and such assistant secretaries as shall be neededto administer the department. The deputy secretary shall have chargeand general supervision of the department in the absence or disability p. 1 SHB 2295of the secretary, and in case of a vacancy in the office of secretary,shall continue in charge of the department until a successor isappointed and qualified, or until the governor shall appoint an actingsecretary. ((The secretary shall appoint an assistant secretary toadminister the juvenile rehabilitation responsibilities required of thedepartment by chapters 13.04, 13.40, and 13.50 RCW.)) The officersappointed under this section, and exempt from the provisions of thestate civil service law ((by the terms of RCW 41.06.076)), shall bepaid salaries to be fixed by the governor in accordance with theprocedure established by law for the fixing of salaries for officersexempt from the operation of the state civil service law.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 71.24.360 and 2005 c 504 s 805 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department may establish new regional support networkboundaries in any part of the state where more than one network choosesnot to respond to, or is unable to substantially meet the requirementsof, the request for qualifications under section 4, chapter 503, Lawsof 2005 or where a regional support network is subject to reprocurementunder section 6, chapter 503, Laws of 2005. The department mayestablish no fewer than ((eight)) three and no more than ((fourteen))six regional support networks under this chapter. ((No entity shall beresponsible for more than three regional support networks.))
